title: flow.issue-draft.requested.v1
description: Flow asks Docs to draft a GitHub issue from a study note. Docs answers with docs.issue-draft.ready.v1 or docs.issue-draft.failed.v1, carrying the same runId and stepId. Only ids: Docs reads the note itself.

stepId.description: The run's step that waits for the answer

onBehalfOf.description: The subject (person) the run acts for: the note's author
